# netbox_ipsec_proposals (Data Source)

Lists ipsec_proposal objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ipsec_proposals" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-ipsec_proposal" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: authentication_algorithm, authentication_algorithm__empty, authentication_algorithm__ic, authentication_algorithm__ie, authentication_algorithm__iew, authentication_algorithm__iregex, authentication_algorithm__isw, authentication_algorithm__n, authentication_algorithm__nic, authentication_algorithm__nie, authentication_algorithm__niew, authentication_algorithm__nisw, authentication_algorithm__regex, encryption_algorithm, encryption_algorithm__empty, encryption_algorithm__ic, encryption_algorithm__ie, encryption_algorithm__iew, encryption_algorithm__iregex, encryption_algorithm__isw, encryption_algorithm__n, encryption_algorithm__nic, encryption_algorithm__nie, encryption_algorithm__niew, encryption_algorithm__nisw, encryption_algorithm__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `ipsec_proposals` (Attributes List) The matching ipsec_proposals. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipsec_proposals))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--ipsec_proposals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipsec_proposals`

Read-Only:

- `authentication_algorithm` (String) Authentication algorithm; not needed for GCM encryption algorithms. NetBox does not allow clearing it once set; leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: hmac-sha1, hmac-sha256, hmac-sha384, hmac-sha512, hmac-md5.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `encryption_algorithm` (String) Encryption algorithm. NetBox requires an encryption algorithm, an authentication algorithm, or both, and does not allow clearing either once set; leaving it unset keeps the current value. One of: aes-128-cbc, aes-128-gcm, aes-192-cbc, aes-192-gcm, aes-256-cbc, aes-256-gcm, 3des-cbc, des-cbc.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `sa_lifetime_data` (Number) Security association lifetime in kilobytes.
- `sa_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Security association lifetime in seconds.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
